title: Dissociation of Microdissected Mouse Brain Tissue for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Liu, Besson-Girard, et al.
materials: Adult Brain Dissociation Kit, mouse and rat

steps.title: Set water bath temperature
steps.instruction: If gentleMACS OctoDissociator is unavailable, set the water bath to 37 °C.

steps.title: Cool centrifuge
steps.instruction: Cool the centrifuge (for 50 mL and 15 mL tubes) to 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare coating buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.15 g BSA in 5 mL DPBS‑CMF to obtain a 3 % (w/v) BSA solution, filter through a 20 µm filter, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Thaw enzymes
steps.instruction: Thaw Enzyme P and Enzyme A from the Adult Brain Dissociation Kit on ice.

steps.title: Precoat plastic ware
steps.instruction: Using the coating buffer, fill 1.5 mL, 15 mL, 50 mL tubes and C Tubes so the inner walls contact the buffer, then remove the buffer (it can be reused). For pipette tips, draw buffer into the tip and dispense once before use.

steps.title: Prepare dissection area
steps.instruction: Clean dissection tools with 70 % ethanol and fill 100 × 17 mm petri dishes with ice.

steps.title: Resuspend and filter cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellets in 1 mL DPBS‑CMF, filter through a 30 µm filter pre‑wetted with 500 µL DPBS‑CMF into a 15 mL Falcon tube, then wash the filter twice with 1 mL DPBS‑CMF, collecting all effluent.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Block cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend up to 10⁷ cells in 50 µL blocking buffer and incubate 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare antibody mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the desired antibody staining mixture, ensuring each antibody has been tested with unstained and single‑stained controls for compensation.

steps.title: Stain cells with antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the prepared antibody mixture to each sample and incubate 20 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Dilute and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL DPBS‑CMF to each sample, then centrifuge 10 min at 300 × g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant using a vacuum pump or pipettes, eliminating as much liquid as possible.

steps.title: Resuspend for flow
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL flow cytometry buffer to the pellet and resuspend.

steps.title: Add viability dye
steps.instruction: Add 7‑AAD to reach a final concentration of 25 µg/mL, incubate 5 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Sort cells by flow
steps.instruction: Sort cells on a flow cytometer (e.g., Sony SH800) in single‑cell mode, gating CD45⁺CD11b⁺ live (7‑AAD⁻) microglia; discard doublets using FSC‑H vs FSC‑A criteria. Optionally sort CD45⁺CD11b⁺ single cells into 96‑ or 384‑well plates containing lysis buffer for plate‑based scRNA‑seq.

description: The protocol below was applied to mouse brains. It hasn’t been tested for other species. The workflow of the whole dissociation process is shown in Figure 1.Figure 1WorkflowGraphic summary of the main steps leading to different single cell library preparation methods
